name: Drawing fidelity
description: Example of the drawing fidelity keys of the component format. The Corner card draws a card whose four corner radii each come from a $switch over the top and bottom fields; the Photo draws a package image whose fit comes from the fit field; the Signal draws a round indicator whose outer shadow y and blur come from the size field, with an icon on top; the Divider draws a pill whose bottom stroke follows the corner arcs; the Link draws a focus ring with its own corner radius (stroke.cornerRadius). The Scroll draws a scrollbar with overlay: true above the Blocks marked inside it, and the Block draws a bar of a color field. The Header draws a translucent bar with overlay: true and backdropBlur 16 over the child markings of its content slot.

annotationTypes.name: Corner card
annotationTypes.description: A 160 × 96 card with a different corner radius on each corner: the top corners follow the top field and the bottom ones the bottom field.

fields.label: Top
fields.description: The two top corners: round (16 px) or square (0).

fields.label: Bottom
fields.description: The two bottom corners: round (16 px) or square (0).

annotationTypes.name: Photo
annotationTypes.description: The package image in a 160 × 96 box, drawn with the fit that the fit field names.

fields.label: Fit
fields.description: How the image fills the box: cover, contain, fill or none.

annotationTypes.name: Signal
annotationTypes.description: A round indicator with a ring icon; the size field sets the y offset and the blur of its outer shadow.

fields.label: Size
fields.description: The shadow size: s (y 2, blur 4), m (y 4, blur 8) or l (y 8, blur 16).

annotationTypes.name: Divider
annotationTypes.description: A 200 × 16 pill with a 2 px stroke on the bottom side only: the stroke follows the two bottom arcs and tapers to 0 at the straight sides.

fields.label: Elevated
fields.description: The bottom stroke: true draws it, false does not.

annotationTypes.name: Link
annotationTypes.description: A text link with a focus ring 2 px away from the text box: 4 px round on its outer edge and 2 px on its inner edge, from stroke.cornerRadius.

fields.label: Focused
fields.description: The focus ring: true draws it, false does not.

annotationTypes.name: Scroll
annotationTypes.description: A 200 × 240 scroll area with a column slot for the child markings and a scrollbar on the right edge that is drawn above them (overlay: true).

annotationTypes.name: Header
annotationTypes.description: A 200 × 240 area with a column slot for the child markings and a translucent 200 × 56 bar on top that blurs what is drawn under it (overlay: true, backdropBlur 16).

annotationTypes.name: Block
annotationTypes.description: A 200 × 48 bar as wide as its box, in the color the color field names. Mark it inside a Scroll.

fields.label: Color
fields.description: The fill: blue, green or amber.
